name: @foreverworks/mcp-granola
description: MCP server that bridges Granola's own hosted MCP server: one OAuth grant held on the server, your meetings, notes and transcripts served read-only to clients that cannot sign in to Granola themselves

mcp.title: Granola
mcp.tagline: Read your Granola meetings, notes and transcripts from clients that cannot sign in to Granola.

GRANOLA_REDIRECT_URI.title: Redirect address
GRANOLA_REDIRECT_URI.description: Where the browser lands after you sign in to Granola; it need not be reachable. Defaults to a loopback address.
